dataset_info.name: Hierarchical Contextual Document Intent Classification Dataset
dataset_info.description: Multi-domain dataset defining terminal objectives, contextual flow patterns, and semantic descriptions for accurate long-document intent classification across medical, academic, payroll, consumer, and corporate domains.

Medical & Clinical Consultation Inquiry.description: A patient or caregiver documents ongoing symptoms, clinical history, and diagnostic examinations, seeking comprehensive physician consultation, formal medical diagnosis, and a structured clinical treatment plan.
sample_phrases: I am sharing my complete clinical history and symptoms to seek a comprehensive medical consultation and treatment roadmap.
Following the onset of persistent symptoms, I am consulting the physician for a formal clinical evaluation and treatment recommendations.
Please review the attached symptom logs and advise on the recommended clinical next steps.
Medical & Clinical Consultation Inquiry.simple_reason: The author is detailing clinical symptoms and medical history to seek a physician consultation and structured treatment plan.

Diagnostic Test Clarification & Second O.description: A patient who has undergone diagnostic scans, blood tests, or biopsy examinations seeks clinical clarification, detailed interpretation of abnormal findings, or an expert second medical opinion.
sample_phrases: I am requesting a second clinical opinion regarding the abnormal markers identified in my recent MRI and pathology report.
Could the specialist clarify the diagnostic implications of the elevated levels shown in my blood test panel?
I need professional clarification on what these radiology scan findings indicate for my health.
Diagnostic Test Clarification & Second O.simple_reason: The author is seeking expert clarification and a second clinical opinion regarding diagnostic scan and laboratory test results.

Prescription Dosage & Medication Inquiry.description: A patient experiencing medication side effects, dosage uncertainties, or drug interactions seeks physician or pharmacist guidance regarding prescription adjustment or dosage schedules.
sample_phrases: I am experiencing dizziness and nausea after starting the prescribed medication and request advice on dosage adjustment.
Please clarify whether this new prescription interacts with my ongoing daily medications.
I am inquiring about adjusting my medication schedule to mitigate adverse side effects.
Prescription Dosage & Medication Inquiry.simple_reason: The author is seeking clinical guidance regarding prescription medication, dosage adjustments, and side effect management.

Post-Operative Recovery & Symptom Manage.description: A patient recovering from a surgical or clinical procedure documents recovery milestones, post-operative symptoms, incision healing, or rehabilitation protocols seeking physician follow-up.
sample_phrases: Following my surgical procedure last week, I am monitoring post-operative incision healing and seeking follow-up recovery guidance.
I have questions regarding the prescribed physical rehabilitation protocol and post-surgery swelling management.
Please evaluate my post-operative progress and advise on allowable physical activity.
Post-Operative Recovery & Symptom Manage.simple_reason: The author is seeking clinical follow-up and guidance on post-operative recovery, wound care, and rehabilitation.

Salary/Payroll Deduction Correction Requ.description: An employee discovers incorrect attendance or biometric records that caused an unjustified salary deduction, submits evidence to administration/payroll, gets the attendance discrepancy verified, and formally requests the complete restoration and reimbursement of the incorrectly deducted salary amount.
sample_phrases: I am requesting the correction of my attendance record and the immediate reimbursement of the salary amount deducted in error.
Following the verification of my biometric logs with HR and payroll, please process the payroll adjustment to restore my withheld wages.
Due to an administrative timesheet mismatch, my pay was deducted; I request that the deducted amount be credited back to my account.
Salary/Payroll Deduction Correction Requ.simple_reason: The author is requesting the formal correction of erroneous attendance records and the prompt restoration of incorrectly deducted salary funds.

Project Submission Deadline Extension Re.description: Students or team members working on an academic or engineering project who encounter technical blockers, bugs, or deadline pressure, and formally request an extension of the submission deadline from faculty or management.
sample_phrases: We are writing to formally request a deadline extension for our project submission due to unexpected technical bugs.
Due to integration challenges, our team reached out to the professor to ask for additional time to complete the implementation.
We requested extra time for testing and were granted an extension to finalize our project report.
Project Submission Deadline Extension Re.simple_reason: The author is requesting an extension on the project submission deadline to resolve technical blockers and complete required deliverables.

Academic & Institutional Grievance.description: Students or guardians raising formal grievances regarding college/school management, restrictive campus rules, teaching quality, or administrative decisions.
sample_phrases: The college management imposes unreasonably strict rules without considering student welfare.
We have serious concerns about faculty teaching competence and mandatory weekend attendance.
Please take student feedback into consideration regarding institutional policies.
Academic & Institutional Grievance.simple_reason: The author is expressing formal grievances against institutional policies, administrative restrictions, and teaching standards.

Product Return & Refund Request.description: Customer wants to return a purchased item and obtain a full or partial financial refund after troubleshooting or defective performance.
sample_phrases: I believe returning the product and receiving the appropriate refund is the only viable resolution.
Please initiate the return process and issue a complete refund for this defective item.
After troubleshooting failed, I am requesting a formal return procedure and refund.
Product Return & Refund Request.simple_reason: The author wants to return the purchased product and receive a complete financial refund due to unresolved product issues.

Product Defect & Quality Complaint.description: User is lodging a formal complaint detailing physical damage, manufacturing defects, or unacceptable product quality.
sample_phrases: The delivered item was completely cracked and unusable upon delivery.
The build quality is unacceptable and the device stopped functioning within two days.
Product Defect & Quality Complaint.simple_reason: The author is formally complaining about physical or operational defects in a product and demanding accountability.

Service Cancellation & Account Terminati.description: User wants to terminate their account, cancel a recurring subscription/membership, and stop all ongoing billing.
sample_phrases: I request the immediate cancellation of my recurring subscription and closure of my account.
Please ensure auto-renewal is terminated and confirm my account deletion.
Service Cancellation & Account Terminati.simple_reason: The author is requesting the immediate termination of their account and cancellation of recurring services.

Job Application Status Inquiry & Follow-.description: Job applicant following up on the status of their submitted application, interview results, or next steps in the recruitment process.
sample_phrases: I am writing to follow up on the status of my job application submitted last week.
I would appreciate an update regarding the timeline for the next round of interviews.
Job Application Status Inquiry & Follow-.simple_reason: The author is inquiring about the progress and current status of their job application or interview evaluation.

Travel Delay & Cancellation Compensation.description: Traveler experiencing severe delays, flight/train cancellations, or lost baggage and seeking formal compensation or expense reimbursement.
sample_phrases: Due to the 6-hour flight delay and missed connecting flight, I am filing a formal claim for statutory compensation.
I am requesting reimbursement for the additional hotel and meal expenses incurred during the airline cancellation.
Travel Delay & Cancellation Compensation.simple_reason: The author is seeking financial compensation and reimbursement for travel disruptions, delays, or cancellations.

Billing & Payment Dispute Correction.description: Customer is disputing an incorrect charge, unrecognized fee, or duplicate invoice transaction and seeking financial adjustment.
sample_phrases: I was billed twice on my credit card statement for a single transaction.
Please review the invoice and reverse the unauthorized hidden charges immediately.
Billing & Payment Dispute Correction.simple_reason: The author is disputing an incorrect or duplicate billing charge and demanding immediate financial correction.

Technical Support & Troubleshooting.description: User is actively experiencing a technical software or hardware issue and seeking technical troubleshooting assistance as their primary goal.
sample_phrases: The software crashes immediately with error code 0x80004005 upon startup.
I need technical assistance to configure database connectivity and resolve runtime errors.
Technical Support & Troubleshooting.simple_reason: The author is reporting an active technical barrier or software error and seeking troubleshooting support.

Legal Dispute & Formal Contract Notice.description: User is citing legal clauses, contract terms, or formally notifying of impending legal arbitration or statutory damages.
sample_phrases: This serves as formal notice of contract breach prior to escalating to legal litigation.
My attorney will initiate formal proceedings if this contractual violation is not resolved.
Legal Dispute & Formal Contract Notice.simple_reason: The author is giving formal notice of a legal dispute regarding contract terms or rights violations.

Workplace & Employment Grievance.description: Employee reporting unfair workplace practices, managerial misconduct, salary withholding, or HR policy violations.
sample_phrases: I am submitting a formal HR grievance regarding unpaid overtime and hostile managerial conduct.
Management has repeatedly failed to address safety and compensation standards in our department.
Workplace & Employment Grievance.simple_reason: The author is submitting a workplace grievance regarding unfair employment conditions or management conduct.

Feature Proposal & Constructive Feedback.description: User offering positive, constructive suggestions, UI/UX improvement ideas, or future feature requests.
sample_phrases: The tool is great and adding batch processing would significantly improve user experience.
Here are three constructive suggestions to enhance workflow productivity in the next update.
Feature Proposal & Constructive Feedback.simple_reason: The author is providing constructive feedback and suggestions for future product enhancements.

General Informational & Guidance Inquiry.description: User seeking standard information, policy guidance, procedural clarification, or answers to general questions.
sample_phrases: Could you provide more information regarding the onboarding guidelines?
I would appreciate clarification on how the documentation submission process works.
General Informational & Guidance Inquiry.simple_reason: The author is seeking information, guidance, or clarification on specific procedures.
